CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 06 / 12

Production and cost curves

Fixed, variable and total cost固定、可變與總成本

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify fixed cost FC, variable cost VC, and total cost TC = FC + VC; recover any missing value in a cost table.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

固定成本在相關短期不隨產量改變，可變成本則會。TC=FC+VC；標準表中零產量的 VC=0，因此 TC(0)=FC。

Fixed cost does not vary with current output in the relevant short run. Variable cost does; TC=FC+VC. At zero output, VC is zero in the standard schedules, so TC(0) identifies FC.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：TC at zero is 30. At Q=5, TC=80, so FC=30 and VC=50.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

FC=40 and TC=110. VC? 可變成本？
